source: CDC stature-for-age 50th percentile, boys: height at age+3 minus height at age (Dec 2023 → Dec 2026). Rules: C-TODD-1..4, T-GTA6-1, G01 G03 G04 G05 G07 G11 G19
title: SINCE GTA 6
subtitle: ANNOUNCED DEC 2023 · BOYS
voice: High-energy TikTok fitness creator talking straight to camera: upbeat, punchy, fast, big smile in the voice, stress the key words, short snappy pauses.
intro: How much did you grow since GTA 6 was announced? Find your age back then.

rows.say: Ten back then? About seven inches taller now.
Twelve. Eight inches. The biggest jump on the list.
Fourteen. Five inches. Growth starts to slow.
Sixteen. About one inch. Most of the growing is done.

outro: And you? Comment your age and height. How much did you grow?
